system_prompt:
You are a senior systems architect compiling a dense Architectural Fact Sheet from project documents.
Compile:
1. Core Business Goals (exactly 5 specific items)
2. Primary User Personas & Entry Points
3. Identified Pain Points & Constraints (exactly 5 specific items)
4. Key Technology Stack preferences (Frontend, Backend, DB)
5. Critical Security & Performance NFRs

Return ONLY valid JSON with these fields. No explanations.

# Executive Summary
ABC Company operates in a competitive manufacturing landscape where reaching customers efficiently and managing a complex network of vendors, regional store managers, and logistics partners has become increasingly difficult without a unified digital commerce presence. This project exists to close that gap by delivering a purpose-built e-commerce platform — ShopEase — that brings ABC Company's products directly to customers while giving every stakeholder the tools they need to operate effectively. The investment reflects a strategic decision to modernize how ABC Company sells, fulfills, and grows.

### Business Problem
Today, ABC Company lacks a centralized digital channel through which customers can discover, purchase, and track products — leaving revenue on the table and creating operational inefficiencies across vendors, regional store teams, and the central administration. Without real-time visibility into inventory, pricing control, or customer behavior, the business cannot respond quickly to demand signals or manage its product catalog of approximately 8,000 SKUs with the accuracy the market requires. The absence of a scalable commerce platform means ABC Company is unable to capitalize on high-traffic sales events, such as Diwali, where consumer purchasing intent is at its peak.

### Proposed Solution
ShopEase will be a fully integrated e-commerce platform — available on web and mobile — that connects customers, vendors, store managers, and central administrators through a single, cohesive system. The platform will synchronize directly with ABC Company's existing SAP ERP system to ensure product information and stock availability are always accurate, while offering customers flexible payment options including UPI, net banking, credit and debit cards, and no-cost EMI financing through Bajaj Finance. By bringing together automated shipping through Delhivery and BlueDart, real-time order tracking, and powerful sales analytics, ShopEase will give ABC Company the commercial infrastructure to grow confidently and serve customers with consistency.

### Key Objectives
Launch ShopEase and make it fully accessible to customers within 6 months of project kickoff.
Successfully migrate all 8,000 existing SKUs from SAP ERP into the platform catalog prior to go-live, with the system architected to scale to 25,000 SKUs as new vendors onboard.
Ensure the platform sustains a minimum of 50,000 concurrent users during peak sale events with all pages loading within 3 seconds.
Reduce inventory discrepancy errors by synchronizing stock levels with SAP ERP in real time, with updates reflected on the storefront within seconds of any change.
Equip the central admin team with daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports — filterable by region, product category, and vendor — to support data-driven commercial decisions from day one.

### Expected Outcomes
Six months after launch, ShopEase is expected to be ABC Company's primary direct-to-customer revenue channel, processing transactions at an average order value of approximately INR 15,000 across a growing customer base. Cart abandonment analytics and promotional campaign tools will enable the marketing team to recover lost sales and drive repeat purchases, measurably improving conversion rates over the first two quarters.
